list_pretrained_models: list all available pretrained CLIP model names and tags using list_pretrained
list_pretrained_tags_by_model: list all pretrain tags for a given model architecture using list_pretrained_tags_by_model
get_pretrained_cfg: get the pretrained configuration dict for a model and tag using get_pretrained_cfg
download_pretrained_from_url: download a pretrained model weights file from a URL using download_pretrained_from_url
download_pretrained_from_hf: download a pretrained model weights file from HuggingFace Hub using download_pretrained_from_hf
